description: Find reporting companies in the MORVS Self-Driving Crash Register by published name or slug. Returns separate ADS and ADAS company profiles, report and incident counts, severity, location, confidentiality index, investigations, recalls and California DMV permits. share_of_kind is a share of reports, not a crash rate. A DMV permit holder may be a different legal entity; the register notes that difference. Reports are each company’s own filings with NHTSA, not a finding, and say nothing about responsibility. The highest injury severity alleged says nothing about responsibility. ADS and Level 2 ADAS have different reporting requirements, are kept separate and are never added together; OTHER is never a crash count. Reports and crashes are different counts. Counts reflect fleet size and reporting rules; they are not rates, are never normalised by miles or fleet size, and are never a safety ranking. The third amended order changed reporting from June 16, 2025, so counts across that break are not directly comparable. A narrative marked as confidential business information is a claim, not an NHTSA decision. No people or narrative text are returned. NHTSA’s caveats are included verbatim.

company.description: Required case-insensitive company name or slug substring, at most 80 characters.
